top.description: Player 1 background (Homer + Bart). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
top.prompt: A highly detailed 2D cartoon illustration in a classic 1990s animated family sitcom style, 1:1 square aspect ratio. A single continuous, seamless, and unified scene of a family living room. On the far left, a chubby yellow-skinned cartoon father with a bald head, two thin hairs on top, and a white polo shirt stands smiling, holding a pink frosted donut with sprinkles. On the far right, a yellow-skinned cartoon boy with spiky hair, wearing a red t-shirt and blue shorts, stands with a mischievous grin, holding a green skateboard under his arm. The background is a pink wall with a simple crooked painting of a sailboat, and a brown CRT television on the floor. The entire middle-center area of the brown carpeted floor is completely clean, empty, and free of details. Saturated colors, bold clean outlines, flat cel-shading. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

bottom.description: Player 2 background (Mr. Burns + Smithers). Formato cuadrado 1:1, personajes a los lados, centro abierto.
bottom.prompt: A highly detailed 2D cartoon illustration in a classic 1990s animated family sitcom style, 1:1 square aspect ratio. A single continuous, seamless, and unified scene of a nuclear power plant control room. On the far left, a thin, bald, elderly yellow-skinned boss in a dark green suit stands with a calculating grin, pressing his fingertips together. On the far right, a yellow-skinned assistant with round glasses and short brown hair, wearing a blue suit jacket and purple bow tie, stands holding a wooden clipboard. The background is filled with glowing green control panels, buttons, and dials. The entire middle-center area of the floor is a flat, clean, dark-grey matte surface with no objects or details. Saturated colors, bold clean outlines, flat cel-shading. --ar 1:1 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, split screen, panels

loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Homer vs Mr. Burns jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous 2D cartoon scene of a card match in the classic Simpsons art style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Homer Simpson and Mr. Burns are seated properly and facing each other across a desk in the nuclear reactor control room, playing a game of Magic. Homer is eating a donut and looking intensely focused on a hand of cards, while Mr. Burns has an evil smirk. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering card layout is displayed: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees to indicate they are tapped, next to an open pink donut box and a can of Duff beer. In the background, Waylon Smithers stands looking concerned and taking notes on a notepad. Warm control room lighting, bold outlines, vibrant colors. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
